description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called PermissionsSettings, which manages and displays the status of various permissions such as location, notifications, etc., in an app. It includes subviews for location access settings and permission status list, and handles permission requesting logic.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: A private SwiftUI View for managing location access settings, including permissions and mode selection.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a list of capabilities with their permission statuses, and provides refresh functionality.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI component representing a single permission item with status indicator and an action button.
